description: This Java class 'CommandContext' manages the processing state and disposition of AMQP commands within the Eclipse Hono client, including tracing, acknowledgment, rejection, modification, and credit flow.

classes.name: CommandContext
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the context for processing a command, including methods for accepting, releasing, modifying, rejecting, and dispostion of AMQP messages with tracing and credit flow.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a new CommandContext instance with provided command, delivery, receiver, and span, ensuring none are null.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the command associated with this context.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the ProtonReceiver over which the command was received.

methods.name: getDelivery
methods.description: Returns the ProtonDelivery associated with the command message.

methods.name: getCurrentSpan
methods.description: Returns the OpenTracing span used for tracking.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the command message with zero credits and finishes the span.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts the command message with specified credits, flows credits if > 0, and finishes the span.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the command message with zero credits.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the command message with specified credits, flows credits if > 0, and finishes the span.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Modifies the command message with deliveryFailed and undeliverableHere flags, flows credits if > 0, and finishes the span.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the command message with zero credits.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the command message with specified error condition, flows credits if > 0, and finishes the span.

methods.name: disposition
methods.description: Sets the delivery state of the command message with zero credits.

methods.name: disposition
methods.description: Sets the delivery state with specified credits, logs, and finishes the span.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Issues credits to the sender if prefetch is zero, used internally.
